description: [$0.003] Live token price, liquidity, FDV, market cap, 24h volume, price change, and buy/sell order flow from DEX pairs, plus deterministic anomaly flags and a local qwen3.5:4b momentum and risk read. Live DEX data, read-only; requires x402 USDC or Stripe MPP (10 free lifetime calls via /api/free/*) at 30-60 req/min.
